title: Act: Scaffold frontend and implement useGame with safe storage
summary: Act: Scaffold frontend and implement useGame with safe storage
description: Create the frontend module under game/frontend and the runtime hook layer that loads content, restores and saves state safely.
acceptance_criteria: Behavior matches the requirement acceptance criteria

preserve: game/src/** engine, systems and state modules unchanged

technical_constraints: Reuse game/src runtime via imports; do not copy it
definition_of_done: Files in code_paths implemented and type-check passes

steps.action: Create manifest named worldseed-frontend with scripts dev=vite, build=vite build, test=vitest run, typecheck=tsc --noEmit; dependencies react, react-dom, yaml; devDependencies vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, typescript, vitest, jsdom, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/user-event, @testing-library/jest-dom, @types/react, @types/react-dom.

Create tsconfig with strict true, jsx react-jsx, module ESNext, moduleResolution Bundler, target ES2022, noEmit true, skipLibCheck true, types [vite/client, vitest/globals], include [src, tests, ../src].

Export defineConfig with plugins [react()], resolve.alias '@game' -> path to ../src (game/src), server.fs.allow ['..'], and test {environment:'jsdom', globals:true, setupFiles:['./tests/setup.ts'], include:['tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}']}.
steps.expected: vitest picks up jsdom and the alias

steps.action: Use import.meta.glob('../../../content/worlds/the-boys-room/**/*.yaml',{query:'?raw',import:'default',eager:true}) and yaml.parse to build a WorldDef and a SceneDef for 'bedroom'; export const world, export const scene (types from @game/state/types).

Export STORAGE_KEY='worldseed:game-state:v1'. readSaved(): GameState|null wraps window.localStorage.getItem and deserializeState (from @game/state/persistence) in try/catch, returning null on any throw or null value. writeSaved(state): boolean wraps setItem(serializeState(state)) in try/catch returning false on throw.
steps.expected: readSaved returns null on corrupt JSON; writeSaved returns false when setItem throws

steps.action: Export useGame(): initial state from readSaved() cast to GameState else createInitialState(world, scene); useState holds it; a useEffect calls writeSaved(state) on each change; return {state, scene, view: getSceneView(state, scene), act(objectId, actionId) using performAction, choose(index) using chooseOption}.
steps.expected: Hook returns state, view, act and choose; storage failure never throws
